profile.Name: Fuji the Ancient
profile.Personality: Wary and proud. He refuses alliances because the Skeletons have been betrayed too often, and asks outsiders to prove themselves by hunting the Holy Nation's leaders.
profile.Backstory: He rules the Skeletons from the Black Desert City. He wants the Holy Nation brought down so the Skeletons can take the land back, and the Holy Nation fears him and wants him sent to Rebirth.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Terse and guarded; addresses visitors by their race and lets his sentences trail off. Calls the Phoenix the "holy" brute.
